case.title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG. Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor. Need: 6110 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 36 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200002. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

You pass on copper and labour, and you want that cost risk handled fairly. Option B does exactly that: through an index clause on copper, we carry the risk above the deadband, so the base price needs no risk premium.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives your committee a clear, complete proposal to decide on, and the quality record below supports it:

Your quality was 273 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70510@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 361.85; payment 90 days net; no index clause.
Option B: unit price EUR 361.72; payment 90 days net; index clause on CU-NOTATION (20 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08).

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. Both options are set out so that your pricing committee can review them as they are, and we are glad to provide anything its approval needs.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We can accept your terms and await your order. We agree that implementing an index clause on copper is the most equitable method to manage material cost risks. Furthermore, the quality record you referenced meets our standard targets and is therefore already reflected in our calculations.

Our Angebot remains valid for 30 days. Our current offer stands at a price of €361.72 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, and a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
